package.name: nros_runner_renode
package.description:
The `renode` runner (RFC-0119 D8, phase-524 W4b). Boots an image in a Renode machine (`[board.run] emulator = "renode:machine"`), with the serial link the board's `[board.run.renode] link` names on a host pty and its console UART streamed to stdout. Renode itself is the plan's tool, resolved by nros (`nros locate tool renode`), never PATH.
A runner package of the same shape as a user's: the announcement below is what the provider scan reads, `nros-runner.toml` is read only when this provider is the one selected, and the executable speaks RFC-0119 D6.
